Our main meal will be served family style, meaning that all of the dishes will be placed on the tables for you to help yourself to a bit of everything - except please note that the vegetarian mains will only be available if you select these as a dietary requirement on your RSVP.


## Mains

* Sliced beef skirt steak with chimichurri salsa
* Smoked chicken thighs with paprika house rub and red pepper salsa
* Sticky BBQ pork belly slices with pickled carrot ribbons

or 

* Smoked cauliflower
* Veggie burger
* BBQ jack fruit

## Sides

* Macaroni cheese
* Watermelon and feta salad
* Sweetcorn
* Creamy coleslaw
* Baby roast potatoes with garlic and rosemary

## Dessert
* Lemon posset, served with a shortbread biscuit and Italian meringue

There are alternatives available if you have any dietary requirements - please let us know when you RSVP.

If you're bringing your kids, please also let us know when you RSVP if they'll be happy with the adult menu or would prefer an alternative.

There will also be various snacks served during the rest of the day.
